exec(open('seq.py').read())
import time
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
def experiment(L, m, rs=(0,64,128,256), lam_rel=0.05):
    A, S = all_data(L); A=A.astype(np.float64)
    useq=np.unique(S); te_seq=rng.choice(useq, len(useq)//5, replace=False)
    te=np.isin(S, te_seq); tr=~te
    pre=f"roberta.encoder.layer.{L}."
    W1=base(pre+"intermediate.dense.weight").astype(np.float64); b1=base(pre+"intermediate.dense.bias")
    W2=base(pre+"output.dense.weight").astype(np.float64)
    H=gelu(A@W1.T+b1); F=H@W2.T
    sc=H[tr].var(0)*(W2**2).sum(0); order=np.argsort(-sc)
    Fte=F[te]; den=((Fte-Fte.mean(0))**2).sum()
    out={}
    for r in rs:
        keep=np.sort(order[:m-r]); drop=np.setdiff1d(np.arange(3072),keep)
        T=H[:,drop]@W2[:,drop].T
        Xk=H[:,keep]
        if r>0:
            # linear directions: ridge of T on [Xk, A], then reduced rank of linear part
            Z=np.c_[Xk, A]
            mu=Z[tr].mean(0); Zc=Z[tr]-mu; G=Zc.T@Zc; lam=lam_rel*np.trace(G)/Z.shape[1]
            Bz=np.linalg.solve(G+lam*np.eye(Z.shape[1]), Zc.T@(T[tr]-T[tr].mean(0)))
            C=Bz[len(keep):]  # 768x768
            P=(A[tr]-A[tr].mean(0))@C
            _,_,Vt=np.linalg.svd(P, full_matrices=False)
            D=C@Vt[:r].T   # input dirs 768 x r
            Xk=np.c_[Xk, A@D]
        mu=Xk[tr].mean(0); Xc=Xk[tr]-mu; G=Xc.T@Xc; lam=lam_rel*np.trace(G)/Xk.shape[1]
        B=np.linalg.solve(G+lam*np.eye(Xk.shape[1]), Xc.T@(T[tr]-T[tr].mean(0)))
        pred=(Xk[te]-mu)@B + T[tr].mean(0)
        err=((T[te]-pred)**2).sum()/den
        err0=((T[te]-T[tr].mean(0))**2).sum()/den
        out[r]=(round(err,4), round(err0,4))
    return out
t=time.time()
for L in [1,3]:
    print(L, experiment(L,1024), time.time()-t)
